runner_static_review.cash_assertion: Before account.execute, expected_cash=held_before*event.cash_ps is compared with newly created receivable using math.isclose(abs_tol=1e-6).
runner_static_review.mark_order: corporate_action -> assert cash receivable -> mark_open_for_held -> account.execute (which calculates opening NAV/order sizing)
runner_static_review.mark_helper: Only a positive, finite, unsuspended opening quote replaces the temporary stale mark; all five affected rows have one.

source_and_download_limits.provenance_limit: CATL/Midea HKEX PDFs and Spring CNINFO/SSE URLs are official-host sources; 300529 and SF full implementation text was read from issuer-notice filing mirrors, with primary-host bytes not saved/independently hashed. Spring official implementation URL was located; official CNINFO adjustment notice confirms the per-share amount and final aggregate change. No source indicates a mismatch in holder gross cash; provenance limits remain explicit.

boundary: Gross scheduled receivable based on record-date holdings is distinct from actual broker credit, after-tax receipt, or cash actually observed. No account holdings, tax lots, predictions, labels, NAV, trades, or returns read; no fit or account run.
remaining_reference_review_cases_from_v1: Three previously reconciled differential-dividend cases remain limited-pass issuer mirrors; this v2 adds the five formerly blocked formula/source cases but does not upgrade those three mirrors to official-host bytes.
